title: Engineering Sustainable Agents: A Systematic Comparison of Agentic LLMs for Developer Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2610.03010v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering, including agentic systems that coordinate multiple agents, but impose higher computational and environmental costs. In this paper, we present a comprehensive empirical study of agentic LLM systems across five software engineering tasks: code generation, technical debt identification, code vulnerability detection, log parsing, and log analysis. For each task, we compare LLM configurations that range from a non-agentic single-query baseline to multi-agent workflows, using six open-weight LLMs, two prompt strategies, and three hardware platforms. We assess each configuration in terms of accuracy, inference latency, and energy consumption. translated_title: 工程可持续智能体：面向开发者工作流的智能体化大语言模型系统性比较
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在软件工程中的应用日益广泛，包括协调多个智能体的智能体化系统，但这些系统带来了更高的计算和环境成本。本文对智能体化LLM系统在五项软件工程任务上进行了全面的实证研究：代码生成、技术债识别、代码漏洞检测、日志解析和日志分析。对于每项任务，我们比较了从非智能体单查询基线到多智能体工作流的各种LLM配置，使用了六个开源权重LLM、两种提示策略和三个硬件平台。我们从准确性、推理延迟和能耗三个方面评估每种配置。我们的结果揭示了智能体复杂性与能效之间的重大权衡：多智能体设计的平均能耗是非智能体基线的6.36倍，运行时间是其6.07倍，在最坏情况下（差距更大）。
tldr: 该论文通过对五项软件工程任务上智能体化与非智能体LLM配置的系统性实证比较，发现多智能体设计的能耗是非智能体基线的6.36倍、运行时间是其6.07倍，揭示了智能体复杂性与能源可持续性之间的关键权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares agentic and non-agentic LLM configurations across five software engineering tasks, finding that multi-agent designs consume 6.36× more energy and run 6.07× longer than the non-agentic baseline, revealing key trade-offs between agentic complexity and energy sustainability.
